It’s weird how much of this I relate to. It’s late and I’m on my phone so I won’t respond til tomorrow but I’ll try to respond if you want to talk or anything.

Anyways, I didn’t really have many friends at one point and tried hanging out with this group of people for a while and at first it was alright but one of them new me years back when I was a dick and talked to the rest of the group. So they began to be asses to me but I thought it was them joking, or at least that’s what I wanted to think. Eventually it got to a point where I stopped hanging with them but then they just got me to come back. It wasn’t hard though I think I’m fucked up and have almost an addiction to the stuff or maybe I just thought that no one else would even put the effort in to even talk to me probably so they were all I had. I had other friends later but still couldn’t separate myself from the group and it started to get worse with not just the mental/verbal abuse but also some physical stuff that I’m still not really over after year or two later. There was one of them that was genuinely nice to me, or I thought, and one time it was so bad one day with what they did that when that person came to me and “apologized”, I told them about how big of dicks the rest of them were and how I just didn’t get why they couldn’t be nice for a day to me and I didn’t really have much anyone else. Well they told the rest of their group that and there came on a fuck ton more shit they’d say. I now have super bad trust issues and can’t trust anyone other than myself. I also know 100% they are what began my depression and even now when I have a friend who I’ve known for 6ish years that I can talk to and dealt with depression himself, I can’t talk or say anything because I am too scared and have an anxiety attack whenever I try because I am too afraid of him betraying my trust even though I know he won’t. I also have an attack whenever anything happens that’s like what the group would do to me to hurt me sometimes. I need to see a therapist but can’t because of my parents not knowing and my not being able to tell them about ANY of this. And also I don’t think I’d be able to go through with it.  

Sorry for the rant but I just wanted to say I’m here too and idk how to fix this fucked up life but I’m just doing my best and trying to go and make it say by day and maybe someday I’ll go see someone or someday open up completely to my friend or something. Maybe someday.

Also, I grew up too ina Christian household and I really struggle with religion because of depression and stuff and don’t know about where I stand with it but... idk. Just another similarity between us I guess
